status: frozen before any Beta.11 family fixture was authored

baseline.peers: gitleaks 8.30.1, trufflehog 3.97.4 (read-only .peer-bin from npm run peers:provision; peer observations from the checked-in snapshots)

rules: Every value is independently authored and unmistakably synthetic; nothing is provider-issued, real-derived, or copied from a provider example or a peer rule's test vector.
Positives are authored against the frozen contract named in benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts, never against current detector behavior. Expectations are frozen before any scan.

A new positive counts toward independence only if both its secret value and its skeleton (value-masked template) are new to the family; the audit script's independentUpperBound and independentAxes are the before/after check.

Each twin mutates exactly one property of the frozen contract, keeps lexical separability, and must not land on a format the same provider issues (measurement-v4 §2.5, #84). Each twin below names its basis: provider (a provider-owned source decides the property), tool-undisputed (tool-corroborated, not in DISPUTED_PROPERTIES and not contradicted by a peer), or context (context-gated or grammar-less value; the value is kept byte-for-byte). A property that sources dispute and no provider decides is never a negative expectation (decision-stop-asserting-provider-undecided-format-properties); #379 drops such a twin rather than asserting it.
Where the observed gap is output action (warn instead of redact), positives state the span and the expected action; a warn is not counted as sanitization (#376, #380).
Nothing in this ledger changes a support status, an expectation, a profile floor, an envelope or a tier.
Budgets are planning numbers, not quotas. A family whose axes are exhausted earlier stops earlier; #379 records the reason.
